info.name: Gazebo - Stock Goods Out Without Plan
info.description:
Phase 2 Tab B — Goods Out without a planning requirement.

**Flows:**
1. **Qty-first batch (preferred):** product list → enter required kg → `GET /stock/goods-out/suggest/` → scan each suggested GI sticker (`GET /stock/scan/goods-out/`) into a cart → `POST /stock/transfer/` with `lines[]` → print/verify/post each OUT.
2. **Scan-one:** scan bag → FIFO/trace → queue single (or `label_count` equal-split) transfer.

Dest auto from `product.destination_container`. Omit `requirement_ids`.

**Tables:** `stock_entry` transfer pair + `stock_entry_posting` / label.

**Vars:** `{{base_url}}`, `{{location_id}}`, `{{product_id}}`, `{{code}}`, `{{lot_id}}`, `{{entry_id}}`, `{{quantity}}`, `{{label_count}}`, `{{entry_id_2}}`, `{{lot_id_2}}`

request.description:
### Warehouse remaining (product list)

`GET /stock/warehouse/remaining/?location_id=`

Product list for Goods Out without plan browse. Same remaining API as the warehouse home screen.

**Path parameters**

None.

**Query parameters**

| Param | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `location_id` | no | One warehouse; omit for all storage units |

**Request body**

**None**.

**Response body**

`{ status, message, data: [ { location_id, location_name, products: [ { product_id, product_name, remaining_qty, … } ] } ] }`

**Status codes**

| Code | When |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | Success |

query.description: Required ledger qty (kg when product unit is Kg)

request.description:
### Suggest FIFO picks by kg

`GET /stock/goods-out/suggest/`

Qty-first step for busy warehouses: enter required kg (e.g. 40), get the GI stickers to scan in FIFO order. Suggests **full sticker remaining** until coverage ≥ required (may overshoot). App then scans those `E{id}` codes on the floor into a cart and queues with `lines[]`.

**Path parameters**

None.

**Query parameters**

| Param | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `product_id` | yes | Product to pick |
| `location_id` | yes | Source warehouse |
| `quantity` | yes | Required ledger quantity (kg) |

**Request body**

**None**.

**Response body**

`message`: `Goods Out picks suggested.`

`data`:

| Field | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `required_quantity` | Echo of request qty |
| `suggested_quantity` | Sum of pick qtys |
| `shortfall` | `required − suggested` when stock is short (else `0`) |
| `pick_count` / `picks[]` | FIFO GI stickers: `entry_id`, `entry_code`, `lot_id`, `trace_number`, `use_by`, `quantity`, `fifo_rank`, pack display fields |
| `to_location_id` / `dest_ok` | Auto dest from product master |

**Status codes**

| Code | When |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | Suggestion built (check `shortfall` / `dest_ok`) |
| 400 | Missing/invalid params |
| 404 | Unknown product |

item.name: Scan bag for Goods Out (FIFO + auto dest)

request.description:
### Scan bag for Goods Out

`GET /stock/scan/goods-out/`

Scan each warehouse GI sticker into the cart after suggest. Returns bag qty, FIFO/trace check (`fifo_ok`, `recommended_trace`), and **auto destination** from `product.destination_container` (`to_location_id`, `dest_ok`). Includes `pack_quantity` / `pack_unit_name` / `display_kg` when the product has a supplier pack mapping.

Main floor control = **trace / FIFO**. Dest is not picked by the user.

**Path parameters**

None.

**Query parameters**

| Param | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `code` | yes | `E{id}` bag / sticker code |
| `location_id` | yes | Source warehouse |
| `expected_product_id` | no | Lock product from suggest / list |

**Request body**

**None**.

**Response body**

`{ status, message, data: { product: { product_id, name, destination_container_id, destination_container_name }, lot_id, trace_number, quantity, pack_quantity?, pack_unit_name?, display_kg?, fifo_ok, recommended_trace?, to_location_id, to_location_name, dest_ok, dest_message? } }`

**Status codes**

| Code | When |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | Scan ok (check `fifo_ok` / `dest_ok`) |
| 400 | Bad/incomplete code |
| 409 | No stock here / wrong product |

### Queue Goods Out multi-line cart

`POST /stock/transfer/`

After scanning many GI stickers on the floor, queue once with `lines[]`. Each line is one sticker draw → one queued OUT barcode. Omit top-level `lot_id` / `quantity` / `source_entry_id`. Omit `to_location_id` and `requirement_ids` (without plan).

FIFO is checked across the cart in order (taking earlier lines into account). One `fifo_override_reason` covers any line that skips oldest stock.

Optional `required_quantity`: rejects if sum of line qtys is less (full boxes may overshoot).

Cannot combine with `label_count > 1` or `unit_moves`.

**Path parameters**

None.

**Query parameters**

None.

**Request body**

| Field | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `idempotency_key` | yes | Base key; lines use `{key}:l:{i}` when N>1 |
| `from_location_id` | yes | Source warehouse |
| `queue_stock` | yes | `true` for print→verify |
| `lines` | yes | Array of `{ lot_id, quantity, source_entry_id }` — same product |
| `required_quantity` | no | Min total kg; error if picked sum is less |
| `to_location_id` | no | Omit → product dest |
| `requirement_ids` | no | **Omit** for without plan |
| `fifo_override_reason` | if not FIFO | One reason for the batch |
| `label_count` | no | **Not** allowed when greater than 1 with `lines` |

**Response body**

`message`: `Transfer queued.`

`data`: `{ out, in, posting, label, goods_out_label, label_count, transaction_count, transactions[], required_quantity? }` — one transaction per line; print `transactions[i].goods_out_label`, then verify/post each.

**Status codes**

| Code | When |
| --- | --- |
| 201 | Cart queued |
| 400 | FIFO override, sticker remaining, short of required, mixed products, or `lines`+`label_count` |

### Queue Goods Out without plan

`POST /stock/transfer/`

Same queue/print path as With plan, but **omit** `requirement_ids` and **omit** `to_location_id` so the server uses `product.destination_container`. Sets `source_document_type=goods_out_adhoc`.

If scanned lot is not FIFO oldest, send `fifo_override_reason` (same as classic Goods Out).

**Path parameters**

None.

**Query parameters**

None.

**Request body**

| Field | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `idempotency_key` | yes | Unique key |
| `lot_id` | yes | From scan |
| `from_location_id` | yes | App warehouse |
| `to_location_id` | no | Omit → product dest |
| `quantity` | yes | Ledger qty (stock unit / grams) |
| `queue_stock` | yes | `true` for print→verify |
| `source_entry_id` | no | Sticker draw-down |
| `requirement_ids` | no | **Omit** for without plan |
| `fifo_override_reason` | if not oldest | Audit reason |
| `label_format` | no | `pallet` or `box`; forces queue unless `queue_stock` explicitly false |
| `label_count` | with format | `pallet` ⇒ 1; `box` ⇒ ≥1. Splits into N OUT barcodes |

**Response body**

`message`: `Transfer queued.`

`data`: `{ out, in, posting, label, goods_out_label, label_format, label_count, transaction_count, transactions[] }` — top-level `out` / `goods_out_label` are the first unit (backward compatible). Each `transactions[i]` has its own `out`, `in`, `posting`, `label`, `goods_out_label` (`E{out_id}`).

**Status codes**

| Code | When |
| --- | --- |
| 201 | Queued |
| 400 | Missing dest on product, FIFO override required, qty too high, bad label plan |

### Queue Goods Out with one barcode per box

`POST /stock/transfer/`

Same without-plan transfer, but `label_format=box` + `label_count=N` splits `quantity` into N equal parts (remainder on the last). Creates N `transfer_out`/`transfer_in` pairs, each with its own queued posting and Goods OUT sticker (`E{out_id}`). Mirrors goods-in `label_count` on `POST /stock/receipt/`.

App flow: print all N labels → scan/verify each → `post_stock` on each (or last per app policy). Balance does not move until verify/post.

**Path parameters**

None.

**Query parameters**

None.

**Request body**

| Field | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `idempotency_key` | yes | Base key; units use `{key}:u:{i}` when N>1 |
| `lot_id` | yes | From scan |
| `from_location_id` | yes | Source warehouse |
| `to_location_id` | no | Omit → product dest |
| `quantity` | yes | **Total** ledger qty across all boxes |
| `queue_stock` | yes | `true` (also implied by `label_format`) |
| `label_format` | yes | `box` (or `pallet` with count 1) |
| `label_count` | yes | Number of OUT barcodes (≥1; pallet must be 1) |
| `source_entry_id` | no | Goods-in sticker for draw-down (checked against total qty) |
| `fifo_override_reason` | if not oldest | One override row per OUT entry |
| `unit_moves` | no | **Not** allowed when `label_count` > 1 |

**Response body**

`message`: `Transfer queued.`

`data.transactions[]`: length = `label_count`. Each item:

| Field | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `unit_index` | 1…N |
| `out` / `in` | Entry dicts for that part |
| `posting` | Queued posting for the OUT leg |
| `label` | Label state (`label_count` on the row is always 1 — one barcode per entry) |
| `goods_out_label` | Print payload; `barcode` = `E{out.id}` |

Top-level `out` / `goods_out_label` = first transaction (compat).

**Status codes**

| Code | When |
| --- | --- |
| 201 | N transfers queued |
| 400 | Bad split, FIFO, sticker remaining, or `unit_moves` with N>1 |
